Class NlsBundleInspector

java.lang.Object
grafiosch.nls.NlsBundleInspector
public final class NlsBundleInspector extends Object
Reads one messages*.properties bundle exactly as it sits on the class path, keeping the information a MessageSource discards.

The guards need three things a merged MessageSource cannot provide: the key set of a single file (for per-module ownership and per-language parity), the raw bytes (to prove the file is valid UTF-8 rather than silently substituted), and duplicate keys within one file (Properties.load(Reader) keeps the last occurrence without complaint, so a duplicate is invisible afterwards).

Reading happens through the class loader rather than through a relative source path. A source path such as ../grafiosch-base/src/main/resources/... happens to work under Surefire but couples the check to the checkout layout and breaks as soon as the module is consumed as a released jar. The class path resolves to the very artifact the server loads.

    • readUtf8

      public static String readUtf8(String resource)
      Reads a class path resource and decodes it as strict UTF-8.

      A plain new String(bytes, UTF_8) would replace an invalid byte with U+FFFD and hide exactly the encoding corruption of German umlauts this project keeps running into, so the decoder is configured to report instead of substitute.

      Parameters:
      resource - the class path resource name
      Returns:
      the decoded content
      Throws:
      IllegalStateException - if the resource is missing, ambiguous, or not valid UTF-8
